title: Findings: reference root cause by hypothesis index instead of a duplicate object
description: Real run with ollama:nemotron-3-nano:4b (2026-11-18): schema-shaped output failed 'root_cause must be one of the hypotheses' because the model repeated the hypothesis with small differences. Replace root_cause (a full copy) with root_cause_index (int | null) into hypotheses: no duplication, nothing to drift. Update aiops_contracts.findings, strict schema, TS wire types and mapper, tests.
acceptance_criteria: Contract uses root_cause_index; out-of-range index rejected; re-run the Nemotron 4B structured check and record the result in ADR-0008.
close_reason: root_cause_rank (1-based reference) replaces the duplicated hypothesis; real Nemotron 4B runs now validate (2/3 first time, 1 clear repair message). Also fixed temperature-0 looping and retry pile-up for Ollama.

title: Fault injector and scenario runner
description: Reads sim/scenarios/*.yaml and applies each fault (config change, OOM limit, disk fill, cert expiry, node stop, CPU throttle). One scenario at a time, with reset.
acceptance_criteria: make scenario S=S2 produces the S2 expected_signals within 5 minutes; reset restores a healthy estate.
notes: Fault mechanics from the demo services (sim/src/aiops_sim): S1 = rollout ehr-api with DB_POOL_SIZE=5, APP_VERSION=v2.3.1 (real deploy event); S2 = patch lis memory limit to 96Mi (< BALLAST_MI 80 + runtime) -> real OOMKill; S3 = PUT /admin/faults volume_used_percent=96 on pacs; S4 = certificate_days_left=5 on patient-portal; S5 = SIGSTOP k3s agent on node-2 (ADR-0013); S6 = raise loadgen RATE_PER_SECOND and lower sso CPU limit (WORK_CPU_MS=5 per request). Admin calls need the estate-admin token. Reset = undo each and DELETE /admin/faults.

title: Add simulated node-2: K3s node in Docker on owezzy-db (ADR-0013)
description: No second VPS. deploy/node2/compose.yaml runs a rancher/k3s agent container (512 MiB, own subnet 172.31.250.0/24), tainted aiops.io/estate=only:NoSchedule. Runbook: docs/how-to/add-simulated-node-2.md. Needs owner approval to apply (two ufw rules + container).
acceptance_criteria: preflight.sh passes; node-2 joins with canary taint; verify.sh --promote passes (Ready, estate taint, untolerated pod Pending, cross-node DNS via VXLAN, host memory >= 600 MiB); docker stop -> NotReady within ~40 s, docker start -> Ready; rollback.sh tested once.
close_reason: Applied 2026-11-18: preflight 12/12, Ready in 20s, verify --promote passed incl. VXLAN, S5 rehearsal NotReady 49s / Ready 5s, 104 MiB idle, production untouched. rollback.sh not exercised (node kept).

title: Demo services: one image configured per catalogue service
description: sim/: FastAPI app parameterised by component id from sim/services.yaml; OpenTelemetry metrics, logs and traces; /health; internal admin endpoint for fault toggles; calls its dependencies so faults propagate.
acceptance_criteria: All six apps run in namespace estate; their dependency calls match sim/services.yaml; toggling a fault changes the expected signals for S1-S6.
notes: ADR-0013: node-2 advertises host memory, so the estate namespace needs a ResourceQuota (memory requests/limits <= ~384Mi on node-2) and every estate pod needs requests/limits, a toleration for aiops.io/estate, a preferred node affinity for node-2, and tolerationSeconds 30 for not-ready/unreachable so S5 reschedules quickly.
